title: Global and International Studies, B.A. - Global Conflict Pathway (College of the Liberal Arts)
notes: Built from the archived 2022-23 bulletin (fetched raw HTML directly rather than trusting WebFetch's summary, per the cross-check convention -- confirmed the page's own printed Suggested Academic Plan subtotals sum to its own stated 'Total Credits 120'). Requirements for the Major section (Prescribed Courses GLIS 101N/102N/400Y, 6cr beyond-level-12/second-foreign-language requirement, 21cr Pathway courses with 15cr in one concentration + 6cr from others + 12cr at 400-level-or-higher) is confirmed byte-identical to the 2026 edition -- no real major-requirement change across this span. Two real, verified 2022-23-specific differences from the 2026 file: (1) pre-Fall-2023 'old' General Education model -- Knowledge Domains are Arts (GA) 6cr, Humanities (GH) 6cr, Social/Behavioral Sciences (GS) 6cr, Natural Sciences (GN) 9cr, Health & Wellness (GHW) 3cr, plus a separate 'Inter-Domain or Approved Linked Courses' 6cr category that can double-count into the domain totals, rather than the reformed 2023+ model's 3cr-per-domain-plus-6cr-Inter-Domain-plus-9cr-Exploration structure this file otherwise carries over unchanged (same total 45cr Gen Ed either way; this plan's gen_ed slot tags are the same approximate/editable placeholders used across every year of this file, not a strict domain-credit accountant, so no slot restructuring was needed -- consistent with the pre-existing GHW/GQ/GWS-only precision already in the 2026 file); (2) 2022-23 uses 'Foreign Language'/'second foreign language' and 'Other Cultures' terminology (renamed to 'World Language' and 'World Cultures' starting the 2024-25 edition) -- relabeled the corresponding slot labels below to match. The 2022-23 Suggested Academic Plan is a single combined 'University Park Campus and Commonwealth Campuses' 8-semester table (120 total credits, no LA 83/LA 283 items) -- the UP/Commonwealth split with LA 83 (1.5cr) and LA 283 (1.5cr) advising-seminar items first appears starting the 2025-26 edition, so this plan (like the 2026 file, which also omits LA 83/LA 283 entirely) needs no such items; the 120cr combined-plan total already matches what this file's own semester structure targets. Global Conflict Pathway substitute courses (PLSC 14, GEOG 126, HIST 120/420, PLSC 414, PLSC 458, PLSC 437, CMLIT 449, COMM 410) are not named in the bulletin's own Suggested Academic Plan (it only ever prints generic 'Major Course from List' / '4XX Level Major Course' placeholders, since the real Pathway course list is departmental, not published in the bulletin) -- carried over from the 2026 file's own curatorial pick after directly confirming each exact course code existed in the 2022-23 university-course-descriptions catalog (bulletins.psu.edu/archive/2022-2023/university-course-descriptions/undergraduate/{plsc,geog,hist,cmlit,comm}/), not assumed.
